verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Next.js offering AI-generated component tests derived from declared props or reactive state. The built-in MCP endpoint for coding agents, llms.txt docs and community reports of Claude Code working well with Next.js are adjacent AI-tooling features, not test generation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can have AI generate component-level tests based on the props and reactive state my component declares
